game_title: Return Or Print – Snow Fort Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about court_score to power up the firewood keeper and open the hearth fire.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
